items.title: Blackbird's new CEO Sumit Rai sets out growth plans as elevate.io passes 1,000 paying users
items.summary: Blackbird PLC (AIM:BIRD) CEO Sumit Rai talked with Proactive's Stephen Gunnion about his appointment, the company's next phase of growth and plans to expand its cloud-based video editing platform, elevate.io. Rai, who has led elevate.io's development since joining Blackbird in 2022, said the business is now shifting its focus from building the product to accelerating commercial growth. Since its launch last year, elevate.io has surpassed 1,000 paying users, giving Blackbird valuable insight into customer needs and its target market. Rai outlined two key priorities: continuing to develop the platform and expanding its customer base. Product plans include enhanced artificial intelligence capabilities, alongside new titling and motion graphics tools to improve the editing experience. He also highlighted validation from Google's Chromebook compatibility work as an important milestone, helping to strengthen the platform's market position. With four years of product development behind it and a clearer understanding of its customers, Rai believes much of the early risk has been removed. He said Blackbird is now entering a new growth phase, with the focus firmly on turning its technology into a larger commercial opportunity.
